findings.evidence: Round-3 RECLASSIFIED P0→P2 spec-methodology. The original P0 'middleware DISABLED' root cause is FIXED: state00 runtime config shows `idempotency_enabled: true`. The middleware is now active globally. The state01 spec STILL FAILS but with a DIFFERENT root cause — a spec helper methodology bug. placeKioskOrderTwice() helper calls placeKioskOrder() twice; placeKioskOrder() does a 3-step flow (quote→store→payment-confirm). Each invocation does a NEW quote request, getting a NEW quote_token. So the FIRST call's store-body contains quote_token=A and the SECOND call's store-body contains quote_token=B (different bytes). The middleware correctly detects this as a payload-hash mismatch and returns HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT — `{"success":false,"message":"Idempotency key reused with different payload.","code":"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT"}` per the state01 assertion observed.body. The MIDDLEWARE BEHAVIOR IS CORRECT. The SPEC ASSERTION IS WRONG (treats two store-payloads with different quote_tokens as 'byte-identical'). Fix: re-architect placeKioskOrderTwice to share a single quote response across both store calls, OR send byte-identical raw payload bytes via low-level fetch instead of the in-browser axios helper.
findings.fix_hint: Rewrite tests/e2e/helpers/kiosk-order.js placeKioskOrderTwice() to call quote ONCE then call store TWICE with the same quote_token+signature+X-Idempotency-Key. Alternative: bypass helper and fire two identical fetch() calls to /api/frontend/order with hard-coded body bytes.
findings.severity_change: P0→P2 (root cause shift: middleware now ENABLED, spec methodology now the gap)

findings.evidence: NEW round-3 finding. State08 verdict=PARTIAL_429_SILENT_ON_KIOSK, evidence='first429=60 counts={"ok":60,"s429":5}'. Kiosk fired 65 order POSTs; 60 succeeded then 5 returned HTTP 429. The kiosk-shell.js bundle line 1198 handles 429 ONLY on the login-screen surface (`if (status === 429) { msg = this.$t('kiosk.login_screen.err_rate_limited'); }`). Kiosk ORDER-PLACEMENT endpoints have NO 429 interceptor — the 429s on /api/frontend/order are SILENT on the kiosk UI (no toast, no retry banner). Operator at the kiosk would see the order placement spinner just spin / time out with no actionable feedback. The POS-side toast interceptor (pos-app.js line 103547+ TOAST_STATUSES with 429) does not apply to kiosk-shell.js (separate Vue app bundle). This is a kiosk-surface-specific silent_error.
findings.fix_hint: Add a global axios interceptor in kioskCart.js (or wherever the kiosk order axios instance is built) that toasts on 429 with key 'kiosk.error.rate_limited' (or similar). Mirror the POS toast pattern: `if (TOAST_STATUSES.has(status)) { kioskAlertService.error(...) }` with 3s debounce.
